purpose: Extract a provenance-aware inventory of geometry primitives, features, and spatial relations from visual or textual source material without selecting a construction strategy.
trigger: A drawing, image, screenshot, text description, model note, or other source manifest needs a structured geometry interpretation before downstream planning.

inputs.name: source_manifest
inputs.type: structured manifest of visual or textual source material
inputs.description: Source artifacts, viewpoints, locators, and readable statements from which observations can be made; each statement must retain observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance.

inputs.name: user_intent
inputs.description: User-supplied interpretation goals or acceptance needs, kept distinct from source observations and inferences.

inputs.name: supplied_constraints
inputs.type: structured constraints, tolerances, or unit context
inputs.description: User-provided constraints that may qualify an observation; unknown or conflicting context remains unresolved rather than becoming a default.

preconditions: The source manifest identifies at least one readable visual or textual source and a viewpoint or locator when available.
Source statements can be distinguished from user input; missing geometry values are not replaced with unmarked defaults.
The operation is limited to geometry description and provenance capture; construction order, application commands, and runtime actions remain outside this boundary.

outputs.name: observed_geometry
outputs.description: Structured primitive and feature observations with source locators, confidence, and an explicit observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance tag.

outputs.name: bodies_and_features
outputs.type: provenance-aware list of bodies, primitives, and features
outputs.description: Case-neutral body and feature descriptions; each item records what is observed, what is user-supplied, what is inferred, and what remains unresolved.

outputs.name: spatial_relations
outputs.description: Relations such as alignment, containment, contact, offset, or adjacency, with their source support, inference rationale, and unresolved alternatives.

outputs.name: symmetry_and_repetition
outputs.description: Observed or inferred symmetry and repeated-pattern cues, including confidence and unresolved pattern scope; no silent repetition count is introduced.

outputs.name: unresolved_items
outputs.description: Missing, conflicting, occluded, or ambiguous geometry statements retained as unresolved items with the reason and needed clarification.

outputs.name: confidence
outputs.description: Confidence per observation group plus rationale, source coverage, and uncertainty caused by inference or unresolved evidence.

postconditions: Every primitive, feature, relation, symmetry claim, and repetition claim is tagged as observation, user, inference, or unresolved and retains a source locator when available.
The output separates visible or textual observations from inferred relations and retains competing interpretations instead of selecting an unsupported one.
The output describes geometry independently of an industry-specific object label and does not choose a construction order or application operation.
The output includes confidence, source coverage, and unresolved items that a downstream geometry contract can inspect.

implementation.target_environment: Visual/text reasoning only; no SpaceClaim runtime or application control.
implementation.notes: No standalone implementation artifact is published; this candidate is a contract-bound reasoning boundary assembled from linked general prompt and reference guidance.

ambiguity_checks: No application geometry is selected; source cues are interpreted semantically and ties are retained as unresolved alternatives.
Audit every reported value and relation for observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance before emitting the output.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation does not create or modify geometry topology.

failure_modes.condition: The source manifest is missing, unreadable, or lacks a usable visual or textual locator.
failure_modes.detection: Check source entries, encoding, and locator coverage before extracting observations.
failure_modes.safe_state: No geometry observation is accepted; the handoff remains unresolved.

failure_modes.condition: Source evidence supports multiple geometry primitives, relations, or pattern interpretations that change the contract.
failure_modes.detection: Record competing hypotheses and compare their supporting source cues and confidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Retain alternatives as unresolved and do not emit a ready geometry handoff.

failure_modes.condition: An observation or relation cannot be labeled as observation, user, inference, or unresolved with adequate source context.
failure_modes.detection: Run a provenance completeness audit over every output item before handoff.
failure_modes.safe_state: Mark the affected item unresolved and keep the complete output out of downstream automatic selection.

recovery.action: Repair or replace the source manifest and rerun extraction from the beginning.
Request the smallest clarification or add a source locator that distinguishes the hypotheses, then rerun extraction.
Restore the missing source or user provenance and rerun the completeness audit before handoff.

validation.method: Review the template against the geometry-understanding stage contract and its linked general guidance.
validation.expected: The operation emits geometry observations and ambiguities only; it does not select a construction strategy or run an application.

validation.method: Inspect input/output declarations, postconditions, failure modes, and recovery for observation, user, inference, and unresolved paths.
validation.expected: Every claim has an explicit provenance class and missing or competing evidence stays unresolved rather than receiving a default.

validation.method: Review identifiers, wording, artifact links, and evidence states for case-specific names, private data, numeric examples, and unsupported runtime claims.
validation.expected: The template is reusable across geometry sources and claims design intent only.

validation.method: Validate positive, unresolved, and deliberately invalid output fixtures with the bound host checker.
validation.expected: Atomic output fields, provenance requirements, local relation references, and blocking-unresolved handoff status are accepted or rejected as declared by the fixture manifest.

evidence_refs.notes: Public design-only review record for this exact candidate template version.

design_only.notes: Atomicity, provenance separation, case neutrality, and the no-runtime boundary were reviewed.

evidence_refs.notes: Host-only schema and neutral fixture check for this exact candidate version.

host_checked.notes: The bound host checker passed structural and deterministic fixture invariants; it did not evaluate unseen-source interpretation accuracy.

spaceclaim_execution.notes: This operation does not launch or control SpaceClaim.

geometry_measurements.notes: No model is measured; the operation records source interpretation only.

visual_review.notes: This is source interpretation, not final viewport or image acceptance.

evidence_level.notes: Evidence stops at design_only and host_checked; unseen-source interpretation accuracy and all application, measurement, persistence, visual-acceptance, and export layers remain unclaimed.
